# Tiny GPT -- Model Card

## What this is
4-layer decoder-only transformer, char-level
Tiny Shakespeare, ~800K params, 128-token context.

## How it was trained
AdamW lr=3e-4, cosine schedule, dropout 0.1,
batch 64, 3,000 steps, single GPU, ~15 min.

## Results
Val loss 1.42, perplexity 4.14. Locally coherent
phrases; no long-range plot consistency.

## Limitations
Cannot converse, answer questions, or generalize
beyond Shakespeare-style English.
